resources.string: Kenya letsatsi la Hijri ho fumana Arafah, An-Nahr le matsatsi a Tashreeq
Kenya letsatsi la Hijri ho bona Arafah, An-Nahr le matsatsi a Tashreeq
Kenya letsatsi le nepahetseng la Hijri. Selemo ho tloha ho 1300 ho isa ho 1600, khoeli ho tloha ho 1 ho isa ho 12, letsatsi ho tloha ho 1 ho isa ho 30.

Kenya letsatsi lefe kapa lefe la Hijri (kapa boloka letsatsi la hajoale) ho fumana hang-hang matsatsi a Hajj a selemo sa ona: Letsatsi la Arafah (9 Dhul-Hijjah), Letsatsi la An-Nahr (10 Dhul-Hijjah) le Matsatsi a Tashreeq (11, 12 le 13 Dhul-Hijjah), e \'ngoe le e \'ngoe e amanang le letsatsi la eona le Gregorian.
Pilara e kholo ka ho fetisisa: ema Arafah ho tloha ka mor\'a motšehare ho fihlela ha letsatsi le likela, u etsa thapeli e ngata, takbir le tahlil. Moprofeta (SAW) o itse: "Hajj ke Arafah."
Eid al-Adha: lejoe Jamarat al-Aqabah e nang le majoana a supileng, etsa sehlabelo, ho kuta kapa ho kuta, ebe o etsa Tawaf al-Ifadah le Sai.
Tsebiso ea letsatsi le letsatsi e u hopotsang moetlo o reriloeng nakong ea matsatsi a Hajj (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah)

Sunnah ea letsatsi lena: kena ihram, u leba Mina \'me u robale moo, u pheta-pheta Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", \'me u rapele moo u khutsufatsoe ntle le ho kopanya.
Letsetsa Jamarat tse tharo kamora mots\'ehare: tse nyane, ebe tse bohareng, ebe tse kholo, majoana a supileng e \'ngoe le e \'ngoe ha e ntse e re takbir, e kopa ka mor\'a tse nyane le tse bohareng.
Matsatsi a Tashreeq: letsatsi la 1 (11 Dhul-Hijjah)

Pheta ho tlepetsa Jamarat tse tharo kamora mots\'ehare joalo ka maobane. Mang kapa mang ea batlang ho potlaka a ka tloha Mina pele letsatsi le likela; yo o lalang o lala a bo a kgobotletsa ka maje ka letsatsi la boraro.
Matsatsi a Tashreeq: letsatsi la 2 (12 Dhul-Hijjah)
Letsetsa Jamarat tse tharo kamora mots\'ehare, ebe u phethela Hajj ka Tawaf ea ho arohana ha u tloha Makkah. A Allah A amohele Hajj ea hau.
Matsatsi a Tashreeq: letsatsi la 3 (13 Dhul-Hijjah)

Tlhaloso e felletseng bakeng sa Hajj le Umrah: tlhaloso le likahlolo, mefuta ea litšebeletso, mawaqit, litšebeletso mohato ka mohato ka bohlale ba tsona le seo ba lokelang ho se bua setsing se seng le se seng, lithibelo tsa ihram, le likopo. Khetha karolo eo u lakatsang ho e hlahloba.

Moprofeta (ﷺ) o itse: “Allah o na le mabitso a mashome a robong a metso e robong, lekholo ka tlaase ho le le leng; mang kapa mang ea a balang o tla kena Paradeiseng.” Tlanya lebitso lefe kapa lefe ho bala tlhaloso ea lona e felletseng, moelelo le bopaki bo tsoang ho Quran.
